# scripts/dev

Wrappers for development and remote execution, for use on the Mac. `remote` uses rsync to copy the repository to a training host, then runs the command there. `record` writes command output with provenance into `results/`.
`pull-results` and `pull-runs` copy results back. `incontainer` and `in-flash-chord` start one-shot containers. `relay-run` moves checkpoints between training hosts through the Mac. `_load-env` reads the host configuration and the credentials from `.env` at the repository root (not in git).
